items.title: 21.14 Thermohaline circulation (garmi aur namak se chalne wali samandari gardish) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of thermohaline circulation (PDF 182-183).

blocks.text: Thermohaline circulation ('thermo' yani garmi, 'haline' yani namak), jise aksar global conveyor belt kehte hain, zameen ke samandaron ka aik bohat aham process hai jo heat (garmi) ko tropical (garam) areas se poles tak le jata hai. Yeh circulation pani ke temperature aur salinity ke farq se chalti hai, jo mil kar samandar ke pani ki density tay karte hain. Equator ke qareeb garam aur kam dense pani surface ke saath polar areas ki taraf jata hai aur apne saath heat energy le jata hai. Polar areas mein yeh pani thanda ho jata hai, aur sea ice banne se is ki salinity barh jati hai; dono wajah se yeh dense ho kar doob jata hai aur gehrai mein equator ki taraf wapas behta hai. Yeh lagatar movement zameen ka climate control mein rakhti hai, hawa ke patterns par asar dalti hai, aur heat aur nutrients (khurak wale ajza) duniya bhar mein phaila kar samandari ecosystems (samandar ki zindagi) ko sahara deti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Thermohaline circulation, yani 'Global Conveyor Belt', ko duniya ke gird aik poora chakkar lagane mein taqreeban 1,000 saal lagte hain. Agar global warming ise slow kar de (dheema kar de) to Europe ko mini ice age (chhota barfani daur) ka samna ho sakta hai, jab ke baqi duniya garam ho rahi ho.

blocks.prompt: Thanda, namkeen pani kyun doob kar gehri current banata hai, aur yeh thermohaline circulation mein samandar ke pani ki asal harkat se kaise jura hai?
blocks.explanation: Thanda aur namkeen pani aas paas ke pani se zyada dense hai, is liye gravity use neeche le jati hai. Doobta hua pani gehrai mein samandar ki tah ke saath equator ki taraf dhakela jata hai. Poles par yahi doobna woh 'pump' hai jo conveyor belt ki gehri, wapas aane wali shaakh chalata hai; garam surface ka pani us ki jagah lene poles ki taraf aata hai.

blocks.text: Fig. 21.15 mein garam surface currents (laal ribbons/pattiyan) poles ki taraf behti hain, jahan thandak aur barf banne se un ki density barhti hai aur woh doob jati hain (neeli ribbons). Yeh thanda, dense pani samandar ki tah (floor) ke saath phailta hai aur aakhir kaar doosre areas mein phir oopar aata hai. Is global conveyor belt ki poori three-dimensional circulation ko duniya ke tamam ocean basins se pani guzarne mein taqreeban 1,000 saal lagte hain. Yeh heat aur nutrients poori zameen par phaila kar climate control mein rakhne mein aham kirdar ada karti hai.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka map aur global conveyor belt: laal ribbons (warm shallow current) Pacific aur Indian Ocean se, Africa ke neeche se ghoom kar aur Atlantic mein upar door north tak; neele ribbons (cold deep current) Atlantic mein neeche south, Southern Ocean mein east, phir Indian aur Pacific mein north ki taraf. Legend: Warm shallow current, Cold deep current.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.15: thermohaline circulation dikhati gehre samandar ki circulation (kitab ki Figure 21.15 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal (garam) pani surface par poles ki taraf jata hai. North Atlantic jaise thande areas mein woh thanda aur barf banne se namkeen ho kar bhari ho jata hai aur doob jata hai; yahi neeli (thandi, gehri) current ban kar Southern Ocean se Indian aur Pacific tak jati hai aur wahan aahista oopar uthti hai. Poora chakkar taqreeban 1,000 saal leta hai.

items: Thermohaline circulation: temperature aur salinity (density) se chalti hai.
Garam surface pani poles ki taraf; wahan thanda aur namkeen ho kar doobta aur gehrai mein wapas aata hai; aik chakkar taqreeban 1,000 saal.
Heat tropics se polar areas tak jati hai.
